// REQ: LANG-901 LANG-902 LANG-903 LANG-904
//// Module documentation.
import gleam/io
import gleam/list

/// A shape.
pub type Shape {
  Circle(radius: Float)
  Rect(width: Float, height: Float)
}

pub fn area(shape: Shape) -> Float {
  case shape {
    Circle(r) -> 3.14 *. r *. r
    Rect(w, h) -> w *. h
  }
}

@deprecated("use greet2")
pub fn greet(name: String, times: Int) -> String {
  let text = "Hello, " <> name <> "!\n\u{1F600}"
  list.repeat(text, times) |> string.concat
}

pub fn main() {
  io.println(greet("gleam", 0x1F))
  let assert Ok(_) = Ok(Nil)
  True && False
}
